gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathologically confirmed diagnosis of high-grade glioma (grade III or IV) or WHO grade II glioma, IDH wildtype (molecular glioblastoma multiforme \[GBM\]).

candidate_evidence.quote: PET scan and MRI scan of the brain, blood draw, and 1-hour of memory testing.
The purpose of this research study is to see if investigators can predict how brain functioning changes after radiation treatment based on PET scans and blood tests.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Anticipated to receive 6 weeks of chemoradiation

source_quote.quote: WHO grade II glioma, IDH wildtype (molecular glioblastoma multiforme \[GBM\])

coder_notes: Imaging/cognition feasibility study (phase NA); interventions are PET-MRI, blood draw, memory testing and lumbar puncture; no drug intervention. FDG PET tracer mentioned only in objectives and not a registered intervention, so not listed (R9). Chemoradiation is background care with no drug named. Glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria as molecular GBM alongside grade III/IV HGG; IDH-wildtype requirement for the grade II molecular GBM route gives cns5 terminology. IDH-wildtype listed as eligibility biomarker defining molecular GBM only; never candidate-matched. Serum/CSF cognitive-decline biomarkers are not tumour molecular markers.
